Sam: Quick sync — AcmeCloud wants to onboard their HW marketplace listing next month. Need a final checklist for marketplace usage reporting + entitlements reconciliation. Can we confirm hourly usage windowing, timezone handling, and fallback for late events? Spreadsheet: https://docs.reed.example/s/acme-onboard
Priya: Added a checklist to the sheet. :white_check_mark: Contract says UTC, but Acme might send PST. We should accept epoch ms and normalize. Also need sample payload and SKU mapping from partner.
AcmeCloud PM: We can send epoch ms. Sample payload (trimmed): `{"device_id":"dev-123","timestamp_ms":1680000000000,"usage_units":12}`. Batches every 15m right now. We'll need mapping from our sku_code -> marketplace SKU id.
Diego: Two ask items: 1) include X-Idempotency-Key header, 2) confirm dedupe logic (is it device_id+timestamp_ms?). Also we need to know expected burst rate for capacity planning.
AcmeCloud PM: We'll include X-Idempotency-Key. Deduping is per device_id+timestamp_ms. Burst for go-live: up to 200/s sustained for a 10m window, otherwise ~20/s.
Priya: Good. For entitlements we map partner_account_id -> Redwood customer_id via the partner provisioning flow. Nina, legal check on PII: can partner send device serial or do we require hashed device id? Also TTL policy for late-arriving usage — accept up to how long?
Nina: Legal prefers hashed device identifiers (SHA256) in payload. Minimal metadata only. TTL: recommend 24h ingestion window for GA; we can allow 72h backfill with manual approval (audit trail required). Add this to the compliance checklist.
Sam: Decision: 24h default TTL; 72h backfill allowed via ops ticketing and audit. Diego, can you implement the following ingestion contract: headers `X-Event-Time-ms`, `X-Idempotency-Key`; accept epoch ms; return 202 + Location header for async batch processing; emit a daily reconciliation CSV for partner.
Diego: Working on the consumer patch. Example ingest response: ```HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Location: /ingest/status/{batch_id}
X-Received: 5391234568``` I'll open a PR with schema + tests by EOD. I will also add rate-limit headers (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining).
Priya: I'll own the runbook and reconciliation queries. We should run an end-to-end partner test next Wednesday 10:00am PT. @AcmeCloud PM can you confirm test cadence and golden file for reconciliation?
AcmeCloud PM: Confirmed. We'll run synthetic load + regular 15m batches at 10:00am PT and provide a golden file (CSV) with expected aggregates for the test. We'll also provide a mapping table for sku_code -> marketplace_sku_id.
PartnerWebhookBot: Reminder scheduled: partner-test-acmecloud-5391234567 on 2026-04-01T17:00:00Z
Sam: Action items: 1) Diego: PR + consumer (eta EOD). 2) Priya: runbook + reconciliation query (eta Tue noon). 3) Nina: update compliance checklist and backfill policy (eta Tue EOD). 4) AcmeCloud PM: deliver sample payload + sku mapping + golden file before test. I'll schedule the partner call and share the runbook link. :calendar:
